title: Lodger

personnel.name: Carlos Alomar
personnel.role: guitar; drums on Boys Keep Swinging

studio_context: Mountain Studios, Montreux, September 1978, and the Record Plant, New York, March 1979; Eno's Oblique Strategies. On Boys Keep Swinging the band swapped instruments: Alomar on drums, Davis on bass.

drum_performances.name: Dennis Davis
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Look Back in Anger: the ride bell over a running kick and ghosts in every gap, 'so many things at once ... and yet it doesn't sound busy' (Visconti).

evidence.note: Drums on tracks 1, 4-6, 9 and 10; percussion on 2, 3 and 7; bass on 8.

drums.description: A frantic, driving beat with a long drum break in the extended section.
